slug.description: Active game slug. Assets are stored per game under .forgeax/games/<slug>/assets/3d/. The workbench UI fills this automatically; an AI/agent caller MUST pass the active game's slug. Required.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the small prop to generate (e.g. 'a wooden barrel', 'a low-poly health potion').

assetSlot.description: 3D asset slot (subdir under assets/3d/). Small props default to meshes.

assetName.description: Desired base file name (without extension). Sanitized + de-duplicated by the store. Defaults to a name derived from the prompt.

modelType.description: Meshy mesh type. lowpoly (default) emits clean low-poly geometry and ignores ai_model/topology/targetPolycount; standard is high-detail.

targetPolycount.description: Target polygon count. Only honored under modelType=standard (lowpoly ignores it; use aiasset:remesh to hit a specific budget).

providerParams.description: Provider-specific native Meshy params (validated server-side against shared/provider-params.ts; unverified/inapplicable fields are dropped).
